clips.title: The story
paras: At Bloodhoof Village, aging tauren hunter Skorn Whitecloud guides young hunters and aids travelers facing Mulgore’s dangers.

Skorn Whitecloud lives at Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore, where he guides young hunters in the ways of the hunt. He teaches respect for the plains’ wild creatures. Aspiring hunters prove themselves against cunning flatland prowlers, then take the claws to Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff. Skorn wants those who take up bow or spear to understand the balance between predator and prey.
